title: pA-Hia5 Protein Expression and Purification
author: Nicolas Altemose
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bv82n9ye
materials: T7 Express lysY competent E. coli cells

steps.title: Transform E. coli Cells
steps.instruction: Transform pA-Hia5 into T7 Express lysY competent E. coli cells for recombinant protein expression.

steps.title: Prepare Starter Culture
steps.instruction: Grow 200 mL of starter culture in LB broth at 37ºC (shaking) with 50 mg/mL kanamycin and 34 mg/mL chloramphenicol to an OD 600 of 0.6.

steps.title: Scale Up Culture
steps.instruction: Dilute 200 mL culture into 2 L LB broth with 50 mg/mL kanamycin and grow at 37ºC (shaking) to an OD 600 of 0.8 - 1.0.

steps.title: Induce Protein Expression
steps.instruction: Induce protein expression with a final concentration of 1 mM IPTG (e.g. 1 mL of 1 M IPTG into 1 L of culture) and grow for 4 hours at 20ºC (shaking).

steps.title: Harvest Cells
steps.instruction: Pellet cells at 5000 x g for 15 minutes at 4ºC.

steps.title: Prepare Cells for Lysis
steps.instruction: Thaw cells (store on ice) and add protease inhibitors and reducing agent.

substeps.instruction: Add 2x EDTA-free protease inhibitor tablet per 2 L of pelleted cell culture.
Add 10 mM β-mercaptoethanol per 2 L of pelleted cell culture.

steps.title: Resuspend and Store Cells
steps.instruction: Add 35 mL of lysis buffer (50 mM HEPES, pH 7.5; 300 mM NaCl; 10% glycerol; 0.5% Triton X-100) per 1 L of pelleted cell culture.

substeps.instruction: Freeze resuspended cells in liquid nitrogen and store at -80ºC.

steps.title: Lyse Cells
steps.instruction: Lyse cells by probe sonication using a Qsonica Q125.

substeps.instruction: Apply 6 pulses: 30s on, 1 min off at 200W.

steps.title: Clarify Lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge lysed cells for 1 hour at 40,000 x g at 4ºC in 50 mL Oakridge tubes.

steps.title: Prepare Ni-NTA Agarose
steps.instruction: Prepare 5 mL of Ni-NTA slurry per 2 L of cells.

substeps.instruction: Wash the slurry 2x with 30 mL of equilibration buffer (50 mM HEPES, pH 7.5; 300 mM NaCl; 20 mM imidazole) per 5 mL of Ni-NTA slurry.

steps.title: Bind Protein to Ni-NTA
steps.instruction: Combine cell lysate with washed Ni-NTA agarose and rotate for 1 hour at 4ºC.

substeps.instruction: Rotate directly in the sealed gravity column to reduce agarose/sample loss.

steps.title: Wash and Elute Protein
steps.instruction: Pour mixture into gravity column if not already present, set up the column, and collect flow-through.

substeps.instruction: Wash with 40 mL of buffer 1 (50 mM HEPES, pH 7.5; 300 mM NaCl; 50 mM imidazole) and collect flow-through.
Wash with 30 mL of buffer 2 (50 mM HEPES, pH 7.5; 300 mM NaCl; 70 mM imidazole) and collect flow-through.
Elute with 30 mL of elution buffer (50 mM HEPES, pH 7.5; 300 mM NaCl; 250 mM imidazole) and collect flow-through.

steps.title: Filter and Buffer Exchange
steps.instruction: Filter eluted protein with a 0.2 μm filter.

substeps.instruction: Load filtered protein onto a HiPrep 26/10 Desalting column and buffer exchange into FPLC buffer A (50 mM Tris-HCl, pH 8.0; 100 mM NaCl; 1mM DTT).

steps.title: Tandem Column Chromatography
steps.instruction: Load buffer-exchanged sample onto tandem HiTrap Q HP and HiTrap SP HP columns.

substeps.instruction: Wash both columns with 5x combined column volume (volume of Q + SP columns) of FPLC buffer A.
Remove the HiTrap Q HP column.
Elute from the HiTrap SP HP column using a linear gradient of 20x column volumes with increasing concentration of FPLC buffer B (50 mM Tris-HCl, pH 8.0; 1 M NaCl; 1 mM DTT).
Save the HiTrap Q HP column for later elution if protein is not found in the SP HP column.

steps.title: Analyze and Concentrate Protein
steps.instruction: Collect fractions and quantify using A280 absorbance; verify protein presence via SDS-PAGE gel.

substeps.instruction: Concentrate peak fractions to final protein concentration > 5 μM using a 10K Amicon Ultra-15 tube.
Supplement final concentrated sample with 10% glycerol (final concentration).
Aliquot, freeze with liquid nitrogen, and store at -80ºC.

steps.title: Quality Control Sampling
steps.instruction: Collect samples throughout the process for SDS-PAGE analysis by combining with 4x SDS loading buffer or 1x SDS loading buffer as specified.

substeps.instruction: Sample 1: 30 μL lysate (pre-sonication) + 10 μL 4x SDS loading buffer.
Sample 2: 60 μL supernatant (post-sonication/centrifugation) + 20 μL 4x SDS loading buffer.
Sample 3: Small amount of pellet (post-sonication/centrifugation) resuspended in ~100 μL 1x SDS loading buffer.
Sample 4: 60 μL Ni-NTA flow-through + 20 μL 4x SDS loading buffer.
Sample 5: 60 μL flow-through after buffer 1 wash + 20 μL 4x SDS loading buffer.
Sample 6: 60 μL flow-through after buffer 2 wash + 20 μL 4x SDS loading buffer.
Sample 7: 60 μL flow-through after elution buffer + 20 μL 4x SDS loading buffer.
Sample 8: 60 μL buffer-exchanged sample (HiPrep 26/10) + 20 μL 4x SDS loading buffer.
Sample 9: 60 μL flow-through (HiPrep Q/SP HP, first column volume during FPLC buffer A wash) + 20 μL 4x SDS loading buffer.
Fraction samples: 10 μL of each peak fraction (HiPrep SP HP) + 10 μL 4x SDS loading buffer + 20 μL Milli-Q water.
